title: BTS 'Arirang' Tour Concludes Three-Night CDMX Run at Estadio GNP
detail: BTS completed the third and final of their sold-out concerts at Estadio GNP Seguros (the renovated Estadio Azteca) on May 10, capping a historic CDMX leg of the 'Arirang' world tour. Combined attendance across three nights (May 7, 9, 10) reached approximately 150,000 fans. Total economic impact for Mexico City was estimated at over USD 107.5 million — a windfall for the hospitality, transport, and retail sectors. The three-night stand served as a major infrastructure stress-test for Estadio GNP following its 2-billion-peso renovation ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup opening match on June 11. SEMOVI and STC Metro deployed additional capacity around the stadium throughout the concert series.

media.caption: BTS Arirang World Tour completes final Mexico City concert at Estadio GNP, May 10, 2026
